title: 美国住房事务负责人谈降低居住成本
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mr. Secretary, welcome back to Bloomberg TV and radio.
segments.zh: 部长先生，欢迎再次来到彭博电视和广播。

segments.en: You are joining us on a day at which, once again, we saw yields climbing, borrowing costs, are just moving higher and higher.
segments.zh: 您今天加入我们之际，我们再次看到收益率攀升，借贷成本越来越高。

segments.en: How do you get mortgage costs down for the American people so long as the bond market is saying there is a serious fiscal and inflation problem
segments.zh: 只要债券市场表明存在严重的财政和通胀问题需要解决，您如何为美国人民降低抵押贷款成本？

segments.en: that needs to be dealt with?
What can I appreciate that? And thank you for having me again. It's always great to be with you all.
segments.zh: 我能理解吗？感谢再次邀请我。很高兴与大家在一起。

segments.en: And as you alluded to, you know, the president made the promise when he came in and all of us in the administration to get the cost of housing down.
segments.zh: 正如您提到的，总统上任时做出了承诺，我们政府所有人都要降低住房成本。

segments.en: And a big part of that was the regulatory environment to cut the red tape, to cut the bureaucracy, not only from the federal government standpoint,
segments.zh: 其中很大一部分是监管环境，减少繁文缛节，削减官僚作风，不仅从联邦政府角度，

segments.en: but also from our localities standpoint. And so at HUD, for instance, we took down the affirmatively further and fair housing rule, which really made HUD a national zoning board
segments.zh: 也从地方角度。例如，在HUD，我们取消了肯定性进一步公平住房规则，这实际上使HUD成为国家分区委员会

segments.en: during the Biden and Obama administration. So we were sending that rule to restore local control back to our states and localisers.
segments.zh: 在拜登和奥巴马政府期间。因此我们发送该规则以将地方控制权归还给各州和地方。

segments.en: And also the president signed two new executive orders, one to reduce the barriers to build an affordable house and then two to increase the mortgage and the credit market.
segments.zh: 此外，总统签署了两项新行政命令，一是减少建造经济适用房的障碍，二是增加抵押贷款和信贷市场。

segments.en: So that the hometown lender, the community bank, the credit unions, if you will, could get back into the mortgage game, which they've been really out of that game since Dodd Frank
segments.zh: 这样本地的贷款机构、社区银行和信用合作社就能重新参与住房抵押贷款业务，而他们在多德-弗兰克法案之后基本退出了这一领域。

segments.en: to help our local and hometown people, and particularly people in rural development.
segments.zh: 来帮助本地居民，尤其是农村地区的发展。

segments.en: And so you take down bureaucratic red tape, the deregulation and increase in the credit market.
segments.zh: 因此，减少官僚程序、放松监管并增加信贷市场供给。
